name: Carnage

angles.text: As a druid, you share Rethiel's grief over the Wetlands' broken balance. Sickness has warped predators like Carnage into mindless terrors.
As a hunter, you know the danger when plague-driven fury strips an alpha predator of its instincts. Then it turns against its own kind.

faq.answer: Carnage is the monstrous alpha of the Razormaw raptors in the Wetlands. Disease has driven the beast mad, leaving slaughter behind and terrifying its own pack.
Rethiel the Greenwarden gives the work. He watches over the Green Belt in the Wetlands and seeks to restore the region's corrupted natural balance.

aliases: why does rethiel want carnage dead
faq.answer: Rethiel seeks Carnage's death because unnatural sickness has driven the beast mad. Its madness shattered the Razormaw hierarchy and devastated the local ecology.
You lure Carnage by placing the malignant flesh and entrails of diseased bears in its cave below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast.

aliases: where do diseased bears come from
faq.answer: The diseased bears are Rotclaws that came down from Loch Modan. Lingering corruption has maddened them, and their tainted flesh draws out the crazed raptor alpha.
faq.q: What are the diseased bears mentioned by Rethiel?

faq.answer: The Razormaw raptors normally keep the Wetlands' natural plant and animal life from overgrowing. In doing so, they help maintain ecological balance. Carnage's madness disrupted that role.
faq.q: What role did the Razormaw raptors originally serve in the Wetlands?

sections.body: The Razormaw raptors once kept wild growth in check across the Wetlands. Now a bloodthirsty alpha named Carnage rules the pack. It slaughters without restraint and terrorizes its own kind. The marshes are in turmoil.
sections.title: A Broken Balance

sections.body: Rethiel the Greenwarden watches over the Green Belt and believes corruption has taken hold of Carnage. Diseased Rotclaw bears came down from Loch Modan. You gather their malignant entrails and place the foul meat in Carnage's cave below Raptor Ridge. The frenzied alpha attacks, and its suffering can end.
sections.title: Luring the Alpha

summary: In the Wetlands, Rethiel the Greenwarden asks you to draw Carnage from its lair. The Razormaw alpha's plague-driven frenzy has thrown the marshes out of balance.
